# Install a ZIP, activate its presentation script, then switch it off and remove it.
# Fixture below is a deflated ZIP in hex with l0_zip/mod.json, a script logging on_start and an 8x8 L0 title crop recipe.
# @env OBL_PACK=l0
# @env OBL_MODS=
# @env OBL_WINDOWED=1
# @gameini Language.Language=0
# @gameini Sound.PlayListCount=0
# @timeout 120
# @expect-log mods screen: OBL_MODS_INSTALLED: l0_zip
# @expect-log mod l0_zip: installed ZIP started
# @expect-log mods screen: OBL_MODS_REMOVED: l0_zip
seed 1
fixed-dt 0.02
await state == 1
await frames 20
await gui-animating == 0
gui-click MainMenu id mods_button
await frames 15
await gui-animating == 0
gui-drop-mod 
await frames 3
gui-click ModsScreen target toggle.l0_zip
await frames 20
await gui-animating == 0
gui-click ModsScreen target toggle.l0_zip
await frames 20
await gui-animating == 0
gui-click ModsScreen target remove.l0_zip
await frames 3
gui-click ModsScreen target archive.confirm
await frames 3
gui-click ModsScreen target back
await frames 15
boot-gameplay scenario 1
await gameplay
expect-text L0_PLAY_CLOSEBUILDING Close shop
quit
